options: Acute cocaine or amphetamine use increases MAC
Onset of anaesthesia occurs when sufficient molecules of the anaesthetic agent have dissolved in the cell's lipid membranes
the constant increase of anaesthetic potency of n-alkanols with increasing chain length
Certain conditions like pregnancy, anaemia and hypoxia increases MAC
